tool_cli_stdout:
usage: render_accepted_expert.py [-h] --candidate CANDIDATE --output OUTPUT
                                 [--ffmpeg FFMPEG]

Composite three native videos of one actually accepted new DR expert. This
tool only reads captured files. It never loads a simulator or a policy. Run
with the existing robotwin Python; no environment changes are required.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --candidate CANDIDATE
                        Fresh candidate that already passed complete quality
                        gate
  --output OUTPUT       New separate output directory; never inside candidate
  --ffmpeg FFMPEG       Existing ffmpeg binary; defaults to PATH or this
                        Python runtime sibling
